name: Tolna

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this mild ripen Chardonnay, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Riesling and Sauvignon Blanc fully without cooking off their freshness.
Chardonnay, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

soil.rock: Loess is fine, wind-blown silt. Fertile and warm, it holds water well but drains poorly. Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its high pH can starve vines of iron and yellow the leaves, so growers plant lime-tolerant rootstocks.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
